nonClaims: POSIX branch not exercised on this Windows machine.
Callers are wired in U12/U13; the ladder runner itself was not modified.
No package.json script is needed for this standalone CLI unit.
No build, Playwright run, commit, publication, owner ruling, main proof or task checkbox completion.
Live CLI reported MACHINE_IDLE at its observation time; synthetic fixtures prove busy classification and timeout behavior.
A process snapshot does not reserve the machine against another lane starting work.
findingsReportedNotFixed: --next returned U4; its in-flight/owner-ruling state was supplied by the charter. No ledger state was changed.

The live admission snapshot contained MCP and agent candidates but no identifiable ladder/relaunching/Playwright runner. The initial broad ladder candidate match was corrected in the admission receipt with the original evidence retained.

CIM and ps expose no cwd: bare node server.js is conservatively busy; arbitrary externally named worktrees without a MekStation path component are not discoverable from absolute server.js arguments alone.
.oxlintrc.json ignores scripts and tsconfig.json excludes scripts. Neither configuration was widened; Jest and node --check provide the direct executable evidence.

Default oxfmt ignores openspec/ via .prettierignore; the default command checks only the three code files. A separate explicit six-file check uses an empty temporary ignore file and two threads. The first attempt to format the local receipt alone under default ignores returned Expected at least one target file; the explicit six-file check resolves that scope gap.
